name: Titanic Video
excerpt: The Titanic Video discusses the impact of competition and operational decisions on the Titanic.
notes: The Titanic Video discusses how competition and operational decisions, such as reducing lifeboats and crew scheduling, impacted the Titanic. It highlights the competitive actions to deliver the Olympic and Titanic, the reduction of lifeboats to avoid alarming customers, and the rushed schedules that contributed to the disaster.
